title: Kamailio At ClueCon 2022
html:
The next ClueCon is approaching, an edition that is organized in Chicago, IL, USA, during October 17-21, 2022.

Kamailio continues to have a strong presences, with presentations and tutorials from Daniel-Constantin Mierla and Fred Posner. The schedule is published at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com/schedule22

A bonus, Richard Fuchs gives a presentation about RTPEngine and SFU.

More details about the event and registration can be found at:

  • https://www.cluecon.com

We are looking forward to meeting and chatting with many Kamailians in Chicago!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
